{{Quote|Um, apparently a thief named Kermollus Preen has managed to annoy both the Skaak Tippers and the Darkwalkers. They want him driven out of the area, or eliminated. Nasty business that.|[[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EHB" />}}
'''Kermollus Preen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] independent thief that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:EHB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> several of his actions greatly annoyed both the [[Skaak Tippers]] and the [[Darkwalkers]], a pair of rival criminal gangs. The gangs forced [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]], a citizen whose son [[Karl Eckener]] was heavily in debt to both gangs, to carry out a number of tasks to pay off the debt. Hugo hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to perform the deeds which included killing Kermollus in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="SWG:EHB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kermollus Preen appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EHB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kermollus Preen was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
